_doc: The forward rule's registry (docs/governance/harbor-ro3-requirements-store.md, drydock RO-3 tranche 4). A delivery event of a listed type appended after the cutover that names no REQ or outcome is announced by `gz validate --catalog`, advisory until RO-5's verbs can supply an outcome id (ruling 4). Events before the cutover are legacy and never read or backfilled. Operator rulings of 2026-10-22: "All nine (Rec.)" for the types, "Timestamp in registry (Rec.)" for the cutover, set when tranche 4 landed. Shape: src/gzkit/schemas/catalog_delivery_events.json; read by gzkit/models/catalog.py.
